study type: Meta-analysis of prospective cohort data for algorithm development
outcome: Proportion of LBW births among specific fetal size and gestational age categories
cohort: The study participants were drawn from 13 prospective cohort data sets in low- and middle-income countries across sub-Saharan Africa, Asia, and Latin America.
finding: The study calculated region-specific pooled rates of low birth weight (LBW) among term-AGA, term-SGA, preterm-AGA, and preterm-SGA births, which serves as a conversion factor for estimating LBW prevalence in the LiST model.
country: Multiple low- and middle-income countries across sub-Saharan Africa, Asia, and Latin America
birth_weight: All birth weights, with specific focus on low birth weight (<2500g)
gest_age: All gestational ages, categorized as term or preterm, for defining fetal size and length of gestation
